text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After going out with Tosen Jordan—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm starving... Wanna grab something 
to eat?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hii, you there, pretty lady~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
In・that・case, how about Italian? There's 
a place nearby I highly recommend.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Itameshi? Wait, what's that? Is it tasty?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, just follow big sis~! I'll take you 
on a tour of all the hottest spots☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the vibe is so nice~ ...Wait, it 
looks super expensive!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I heard it's famous for its delicious 
wine.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's also grape juice made by a 
winemaker. Want some?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm totes drinking it! Love grapes! Ah, 
but isn't the price kinda insane...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, fufu♪ Well, it's true there are 
expensive ones, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Italian food looks fancy, but it's 
actually pretty reasonably priced, which 
is nice. Plus, table manners aren't too 
strict."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
In other words! It's a totally hip, 
happening spot for all the groovy young 
people♪ Let's just have fun first!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? Italian food is awesome! Guess 
I gotta chow down big time♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The menu is on the wall over there♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Pizza, pasta... No way! Seriously!? 
Itameshi is just full of stuff I already 
know!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really!? Jordan-chan, what have you 
been calling Italian food this whole 
time...!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Phew, I am stuffed! The pizza and the 
pasta were both so good!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: As expected of Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah~! Leave all the latest trends 
to this gal~!

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Haha, there was a time when it was all 
over the TV every single day, wasn't 
there~?

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's precisely because of the 
trends back then that I'm able to truly 
immerse myself in cooking like this now...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... The trends back then...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, back then...? Not right now!?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Jordan-chan! Italian food is still 
totally hip and trendy, right?! And 
tiramisu too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehh? Hmm... I don't really get it, but~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If it tastes good, then it's totally fine, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I just posted pics of the food and 
the shop, and Umastagram's already hitting 
it with 'Yummy's!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't this, like, totally cutting-edge 
trendiness!? The times are finally 
catching up to you, Maruzen-san!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...The times have finally caught up with 
me...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ayyy! That's how it's gonna be~â
choice_data_list:
You didn't just say that to go along with 
it... did you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Duh, of course! Maruzen-san is the 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe! All right, I'm gonna keep racing 
ahead at the very forefront of fashion~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-wee! Keep going all out from here on 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Tosen Jordan's quick save, 
disaster was averted...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No it isn't. I'm being totally 
serious.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks, Jordan-chan. That made me 
really happy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aww, dang~... Oh, wait! Wanna take a 
selfie? Like, a keepsake photo with 
Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the photo featuring the two of 
them spread, and the Ita-han restaurant 
instantly became a trendy spot.
